notes.title: Can you find all ten seedlings?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/54e8bbbb8eaf77b94d2fb496b10ee6c82823e140.png[/img]

If you’ve played the Airport Renovator demo, you might have noticed there are small plants called seedlings are hidden in various places around your future airport. You might collect them and then use them freely to put different plants anywhere you like. You can create a garden if you so desire! Your creativity is the only restriction here.

While the seedlings are an excellent addition, they are not easy to find! Only a few players we know have managed to find all ten of them cause they are hidden in places you don’t often go to.

notes.title: The Axe - one tool to rule them all
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/14dedc36007a5dc6f60d9f8e342ec13ade52d7b6.png[/img]

You’ve just acquired your first airport, and it’s in a terrible state. The only thing you have in your inventory is an Axe! This most basic of tools will help you out going through the game, and you will find yourself using it for plenty of things. 

[h3]Chop down those trees![/h3]

How many swings do you need to get a tree down? Three, four, or maybe just one power-swing will be enough? Try it out for yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/713f0368dbd93d9db8d4978a3f5c3ca4db9863d2.png[/img]

[h3]Get rid of the trash![/h3]

Smash those not-needed pieces of old furniture with your trusty axe. Get rid of all the things you don’t need and make space for new ones!

[h3]Crack those crates open! [/h3]

Once in a while, your friend Amelia sends you an airdrop with a new tool or airport decoration element inside. It comes in a solid wooden box that you need to chop up with nothing else than your trusty axe!



https://store.steampowered.com/app/1356250/Airport_Renovator/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/e271ee6d8ea0447ecad86a6e1c30c65240848ae8.png[/img]

The Steam Next Fest was a blast, and we’ve had a lot of fun playing the Airport Renovator demo with you guys. Thank you for being there with us once again. Now it’s time to sum it all up.

[b]The Airport Renovator on Steam Next Fest:[/b]

21,237 - demo downloads
209 - the peak of online players
50 minutes - a median of playing
200 - YouTube videos
2,432,701 - total YouTube views
100,000 - total game views on Steam
5th place - the most downloaded game in the simulators category
16th place - most downloaded game of all Festival games
25% - Discord members growth in a week

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/f2e31150b9804b30b5a7f383f00b38838f02ed5b.png[/img]

notes.title: The first update for the Airport Renovator demo is here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/eac89b387dec0fce567fc88ed995405fa4dcc7c9.png[/img]

You’ve spoken and we’ve listened. [b]The Airport Renovator demo[/b] is really popular and your response to it is simply amazing. You have addressed some things that could be optimized and we’ve figured them out, then we’ve added some of our own and here it is, [b]the first patch[/b] is now live.  


[b]Changelog:[/b]

- Optimized the scene to run much better on slower PC configurations 
- Tweaked the visual settings at all the fidelity levels available from the Graphics Options menu 
- Implemented Nvidia DLSS - can be turned on in the Display Options menu to further boost performance at the cost of slightly reduced visual fidelity 
- Nerfed the goat - doesn't bleat nearly as much and can now be politely told to go away by interacting with it using the "F" key (will come back when asked nicely using the same interaction) 
- Added Goat Volume™ functionality to the Audio Options menu 
- Fixed the "100% complete" achievement not popping up reliably for some players

notes.title: Is it a bird? Is it a plane? No, it’s a loot crate!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/7dae73575661c92c51d8989d963f718c20052a85.png[/img]

A[b] loot crate [/b]in the [b]Airport Renovator[/b] is like a box of chocolates. You never know what you’re gonna get! Well, almost. But let’s start from the beginning.

Depending on the game’s story, once in a while, your in-game pilot friend will (whose identity we don’t want to disclose at the moment) airdrops you a large wooden box. You will quickly recognize a majestic umbrella of a parachute slowly descending into the old airstrip. After it lands, you need to [b]grab your axe [/b]and chop that tangible thing into pieces. Let me tell you - [b]it’s a satisfying process[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/fa22862afa58315572f7c5e23a6ef38251a08085.png[/img]

After that, you can finally grab your reward. Boxes can contain [b]a tool [/b]for your arsenal, an element of the [b]airport equipment[/b], or even something that you don’t expect! For example, after you’ve received a grass trimmer, it is added to your tool shed forever, and you can start using it right away. 

[b]Airdrops [/b]are a crucial part of the Airport Renovator gameplay, and from the moment you see a wooden crate flying through the air to the moment you take a new toy into your hand, they are pure joy.

notes.title: Trim your bush with a grass trimmer!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/e07560b94b264e5a87720507e4241d200c47d50a.png[/img]

In [b]Airport Renovator[/b], it’s you and your tools against Mother Nature. The airport you’re taking care of needs a human hand, and it needs it now! When you enter the game first, you see the overgrown bushes, the trees that are way too high for any pilot to see through them, and the grass that covers the airfield like a vast, green carpet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/62daa2144353de380ba11e26c9e714a7e9c31747.gif[/img]

Here is where your trusty [b]grass trimmer[/b] comes into play, start it up and trim away! Leave no bush unattended and no grass obstructing the essential parts of the airport. Don’t worry. The process of trimming is relaxing, and you can’t cut yourself while doing it. It’s just a game, after all…

Prepare the airport area for the next game stage with your grass trimmer, and remember - [b]a trimmed airfield makes the plane appear bigger![/b]

notes.title: Fight the forces of nature
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/0c5c355cde1a3566295865892c726f49f1acfcf9.png[/img]

It’s been a long time since this [b]airport [/b]has been used for its purpose. Gradually, nature has been taking over and you can see it with your own eyes. Between the green grass and tall bushes, there are still some visible signs of human activity, but in a few years, you most probably couldn’t even tell that[b] it used to be a busy place[/b] full of people. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/54d02e69c710a7a04846259caeb21a9608fecc47.png[/img]

This is where you come into the game, my dear friend. With [b]your own two hands[/b] and with a specific [b]set of tools[/b] at your disposal, you are going to transform this airport into a fully functioning place, full of planes departing and arriving and full of satisfied passengers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/9668d98e48b9f2216e3eee377d5806e294aee2fa.png[/img]
